citations.review_text: Game doesn't support rebinding the controls.
You can't remap controls. Using the right bumper as shoot is the weirdest thing I've ever seen. And a great way to make your hand cramp up.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the camera and mouse movement as linked to the character, making it difficult to aim and dodge simultaneously.

citations.review_text:
-unplayable on controller
camera moves around the character. Aiming demands 0.5s precision kills, while enemies moves at lightning speed
-weak story
-weak combat

Unplayable on pc with the camera controls. The mouse moves dependently of the character. A truly mind-boggling game design choice... Never in my life have I seen a top down game where the cursor will move with your character. 
The result of this is that it's basically impossible (or at least insanely difficult) to do something simple like dodge an enemy and fight back at the same time. You literally have to multitask counteracting your movements with the mouse when avoiding enemy attacks, and trying to land a shot at the same time. The best part is there is no way to change the camera controls. It's not like that on console, and no other top down game does this. seriouly wtf... Just play intravenous or something, this game is not the move.

citations.review_text: Hotline Miami is a thrilling, fast-paced masterpiece that pairs brutal top-down action with a pulsing, unforgettable electronic soundtrack. Its high-difficulty, instant-respawn gameplay creates a mesmerizing loop of trial and error, while the surreal, neon-soaked 1980s aesthetic and trippy story keep you hooked until the very end.

Bought game for 0.49

Fkn worth it

Fast paced hell with a good soundtrack and guts galore

A bit difficult but you get the hang of it

The gameplay is challenging, but in all the right ways. It's a bloody, brutal, and adrenaline-fueled experience that keeps you engaged from start to finish. It gives you complete freedom to approach each level however you want. You can take your time, plan every move, and eliminate enemies stealthily, or charge in headfirst and leave nothing but chaos behind. Both playstyles are equally satisfying. Since a single hit is enough to kill you, every encounter keeps you on edge, and even the smallest mistake can cost you the entire run.

Between the intense missions, the game unfolds a cryptic, symbolism-filled story that intentionally leaves you confused, encouraging you to piece everything together in your own way. The retro aesthetic, combined with its surreal narrative exploring just how brutal humanity can become, gives the game a unique and unforgettable identity.

The soundtrack is nothing short of phenomenal. Every track perfectly matches the game's atmosphere, and I enjoyed it so much that I downloaded several songs to my phone—I still listen to them regularly.

Getting every achievement was a rewarding challenge, especially the "Get A Life" achievement. It demanded a lot of patience and persistence, but finally unlocking it made the experience even more satisfying.

citations.review_text: Hotline Miami is a thrilling, fast-paced masterpiece that pairs brutal top-down action with a pulsing, unforgettable electronic soundtrack. Its high-difficulty, instant-respawn gameplay creates a mesmerizing loop of trial and error, while the surreal, neon-soaked 1980s aesthetic and trippy story keep you hooked until the very end.

Bought game for 0.49

Fkn worth it

Fast paced hell with a good soundtrack and guts galore

A bit difficult but you get the hang of it

Definitely got more fun the more I got used to the controls. This is a HARD game, but the game knows this, so failing never feels super crushing or tedious (it takes <1 second to respawn). 

Graphics and Music are definitely a highlight of the game in my eyes. Super huge fan of the neon vibe that the game is going for. 

Gameplay is hard yes, but it's incredibly satisfying once you get the hang of it. Each kill feels super good to pull off, and combos especially are very satisfying. The lock-in mechanic was a little weird for me to get the hang of tho.

I wish the story leaned a little more into the pacifist angle. That's what it's going for, but I think the game could've used a bit more of story to flesh the theming out a bit idk.

Not really my type of game, but a good game nonetheless.

7/10
